aged-sepia.$description: Aged Sepia — Primary text, borders, icons, strokes — the near-brown warmth softens digital harshness without sacrificing legibility. Appears across every UI context from nav to body to buttons.

parchment.$description: Parchment — Page backgrounds, card surfaces, heading text on dark — the cream canvas against which all content rests. Acts as both background and reversed foreground.

fog.$description: Fog — Button fills, borders, dividers — a muted gray-beige midtone that bridges Parchment and Aged Sepia without introducing new chromatic energy.

absolute-black.$description: Absolute Black — Footer backgrounds, high-contrast text inversion — appears sparingly, reserved for terminal anchoring at page bottom.

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card backgrounds, reversed text, button fills — pristine whites float above Parchment base, creating layered depth.

moss-shadow.$description: Moss Shadow — Secondary body text, muted labels — a desaturated brown-gray for deemphasized content.

deep-forest.$description: Deep Forest — Nav backgrounds on scroll, elevated surfaces — a near-black with faint greenish tint echoing the botanical imagery.

teal-accent.$description: Teal Accent — Nav active states, subtle highlights — the only cool color in a warm palette, used sparingly for interactive focus.

ash-mist.$description: Ash Mist — Tertiary text, disabled states — lightest text color before transitioning to pure white.

slate-edge.$description: Slate Edge — Headline text, button borders — nearly black but slightly warmer, used for maximum contrast without harshness.

pplxsans.$description: Interface workhorse — nav, body, buttons, badges, links at 11-16px for UI, 32-96px for hero headlines. Weight 300 at display sizes creates authority through whisper-weight restraint. Custom typeface ensures brand distinction unavailable through system fonts.

pplxsansmono.$description: Code snippets, technical badges (/query markers), status labels — monospace grounds the AI agent narrative in developer credibility. Appears at 10-14px in buttons and badges.

pplxserif.$description: Section headlines, declaration moments — serif at 48-96px creates editorial gravitas, separating feature announcements from interface chrome. Weight 300 at 72-96px continues the whisper-weight authority pattern.
